title: Glimpse of Shanghai
alt: Pudong skyline across the Huangpu river from the Bund
transport: Private airport transfers and a guided half day

stops.name: Shanghai
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel in Jing'an, two metro stops from the centre

activities.name: Shanghai half day sightseeing tour
activities.description: The Bund waterfront, the lanes of the old town and the Yu garden with its teahouse, with a guide for the morning.

activities.name: Oriental Pearl Tower
activities.description: The lifts up the Oriental Pearl Tower to the observation spheres, with the glass floor looking straight down on Pudong.

activities.name: Huangpu river cruise
activities.description: A cruise along the Huangpu between the colonial facades of the Bund and the lit towers of Pudong.

program.name: Shanghai
program.description: Two nights in the city with a guided half day, the Pearl Tower and a river cruise after dark.

day_titles.2: Shanghai city tour and river cruise

1: Arrival at Pudong or Hongqiao and transfer to your hotel
Check in and the rest of the day free
Optional: an evening walk on the Bund
Optional: dinner in the Xintiandi lanes
2: Breakfast, then a guided half day of the city
The Bund, the old town lanes and the Yu garden
Up the Oriental Pearl Tower in the afternoon
A cruise on the Huangpu as the towers light up
3: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to the airport for your flight home

expert.name: Mei
expert.quote: Two nights is enough for Shanghai if you spend one evening on the water. The skyline is the whole point of the city.
expert.tip: Take the river cruise after dark rather than at dusk. The towers only switch everything on once the light has gone.

summary: A short city break: two nights in Shanghai with a guided half day through the Bund, the old town and the Yu garden, the Oriental Pearl Tower, and a Huangpu river cruise under the lit skyline.
included: Included: 2 nights with daily breakfast; private airport transfers; a half day guided tour of Shanghai; Oriental Pearl Tower tickets; a Huangpu river cruise.
not_included: Not included: international flights; China visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
